# Notion Research Report

## Company Overview

- Notion was founded in 2013. [6]
- Notion was founded in 2014. [4]
- Notion is a privately held company backed by venture capital. [6]
- Notion's official website is www.notion.com. [6]
- Notion's headquarters is located at 51 Lloyd Baker Street, London, England, WC1X 9AA, United Kingdom. [4]
- Notion develops an online work collaboration platform for task and project management, designed to improve team and individual productivity. [6]
- Notion was formerly known as Canopy Technologies. [6]
- Notion has approximately 1,200 employees. [6]

## Industry Overview

- Notion operates in the collaborative workspace and productivity software industry, competing with companies like Microsoft, Atlassian, Airtable, Slack, ClickUp, monday.com, Asana, Coda, Obsidian, and Roam Research. [1]
- Notion views its competition broadly — not as single-point rivals but as parts of an entire industry it aims to consolidate, per CEO Ivan Zhao's 'Legos' analogy. [2]
- Microsoft launched Loop in November 2021 as a direct competitor to Notion, integrated into Microsoft 365. [3]
- Legacy note-taking company Evernote declined due to pricing missteps and product stagnation, creating space for Notion and newer entrants like Coda and Roam Research. [2]
- Enterprise incumbents Microsoft and Atlassian pose key competitive risks to Notion, especially as they leverage existing distribution and procurement entrenchment in large organizations. [3]
